ask: C11. arena.h and arena.c: bump allocator over a malloc'd block. arena_new(size), arena_alloc(size, align), arena_mark/arena_reset, arena_free. alignment up to 64 bytes, returns NULL on overflow. write the files.
prose:
Both files are written.

`arena.h` declares the four public functions plus the opaque `ArenaMark` typedef. `arena.c` keeps the `Arena` header and its data region in a single `malloc` so `arena_free` is one `free()` call. Alignment is handled with a power-of-two mask (`align_up`), capped at 64. Overflow is caught in two places: a `size_t` wraparound check before the capacity check, so neither can silently succeed.
